items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: And there were names, you know, all the names for the dice came up. Little Joe and Craps and Four and Eight, the Hard Way

ctx.x: Yeah. Meaning, I dare you to throw the dice out and put some money on the table, I'm going to beat you. And if you do it twice, I'm going to beat you twice. If you do it ten times, I'll beat you... You know, that kind of thing. And there were names, you know, all the names for the dice came up. Little Joe and Craps and Four and Eight, the Hard Way, meaning you only got two identical numbers. All those kinds of things. A lot of them I don't remember anymore. And also, how cards were marked.
